requirements.text: The system shall allow an employee to submit an annual leave request with start and end dates.
ac: The request shows the number of working days requested.

requirements.text: The system shall prevent a leave request that exceeds the remaining balance.
ac: Requesting 6 days with a balance of 5 shows an error.

requirements.text: The system shall notify the direct manager when a request is submitted.
ac: The manager receives an in-app notification and an email.

requirements.text: The manager must approve or reject a request within 3 working days.
ac: After 3 working days the request escalates to HR.

requirements.text: The system shall exclude public holidays from the calculated leave days.
ac: A request spanning a public holiday counts one day fewer.
